name.ar: Perimeter Institute PSI Start: المدرسة الصيفية والتدريب البحثي 2027

stipend.en: Research Award prorated to length of stay (amount not published), plus economy airfare, ground transport, housing assistance and meal credit

duration.en: Two-week school (14-25 June 2027) and paid internship of 12-15 weeks (3 May - 20 Aug 2027)
duration.ka: ორკვირიანი სკოლა (14-25 ივნისი 2027) და 12-15 კვირიანი ანაზღაურებადი ინტერნშიპი
duration.ar: مدرسة لأسبوعين (14-25 يونيو 2027) وتدريب مدفوع من 12 إلى 15 أسبوعًا

deadline_note: Applications due 17 Jan 2027; internships awarded by end of February 2027.

summary.en: Perimeter Institute's undergraduate summer programmes in theoretical physics: a no-fee two-week school and a paid research internship of up to 15 weeks.
summary.ka: Perimeter Institute-ის საზაფხულო პროგრამები თეორიულ ფიზიკაში: უფასო ორკვირიანი სკოლა და ანაზღაურებადი კვლევითი ინტერნშიპი 15 კვირამდე.
summary.ar: برامج Perimeter Institute الصيفية للفيزياء النظرية: مدرسة مجانية لأسبوعين وتدريب بحثي مدفوع حتى 15 أسبوعًا.

about.en:
PSI Start offers undergraduates planning graduate study in physics a two-week summer school at Perimeter Institute (about 30 students, 14-25 June 2027, no fee, with travel support, accommodation and food) and a paid in-person research internship of at least 12 weeks between 3 May and 20 August 2027. Interns are selected from the same application and also attend the June school.

Applicants should be in their second-to-last undergraduate year (or in their final year if they plan to start graduate school in 2028 or later) and know Lagrangian/Hamiltonian mechanics, basic quantum mechanics and linear algebra by the start. Applications are made once, online.

en: Paid research internship with theoretical physicists
Summer school with travel, housing and meals covered
Students worldwide may apply
ka: სკოლა გზის, საცხოვრებლისა და კვების დაფარვით
ar: تدريب بحثي مدفوع مع فيزيائيين نظريين
مدرسة صيفية بتغطية السفر والسكن والطعام

eligibility.en: Students around the world who meet the criteria may apply; no country restrictions are listed. Must be in the second-to-last undergraduate year (or final year, planning to start graduate studies in 2028 or later); students starting a physics graduate programme in 2027 generally cannot apply. International interns need a visitor visa and/or eTA.

en: Check eligibility on the programme page and FAQ
Apply online through the academicjobsonline posting (job ID 33186) by 17 January 2027
Select the research internship option if you want it
Internship offers are made by end of February 2027

costs.en: Summer school: no fee, with travel support, accommodation and food. Internship: paid Research Award (amount not published), airfare and local transport, housing assistance and meal credit.

score_reason: Top theoretical physics institute; paid, open to students worldwide; deadline 17 Jan 2027

name.en: Rockefeller University Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF) 2027

stipend.en: USD 6,500 stipend; free housing for students who cannot commute

deadline_note: Summer 2027 application is open; deadline 1 Feb 2027, notifications mid-March.

summary.en: Ten-week paid biomedical research fellowship in a Rockefeller University lab, open to college sophomores and juniors, including international students.
summary.ka: ათკვირიანი ანაზღაურებადი ბიოსამედიცინო კვლევითი სტიპენდია როკფელერის უნივერსიტეტის ლაბორატორიაში; ღიაა მეორე და მესამე კურსის სტუდენტებისთვის, საერთაშორისოებისთვისაც.
summary.ar: زمالة بحثية طبية حيوية مدفوعة لمدة 10 أسابيع في مختبر بجامعة روكفلر لطلاب السنة الثانية والثالثة، ويمكن للطلاب الدوليين التقديم.

about.en:
The Chemers Neustein SURF Program places undergraduates in a Rockefeller University laboratory in New York City for ten weeks of full-time research (7 June to 13 August 2027). Participants receive a USD 6,500 stipend and free housing if they cannot commute.

College sophomores and juniors are eligible and the page states that international students may apply. Applications go through the online SURF application system; decisions are announced in mid-March 2027.

en: USD 6,500 stipend plus free housing
Ten weeks in a world-leading biomedical lab
International students may apply
ka: ათი კვირა მსოფლიო დონის ბიომედიცინულ ლაბორატორიაში
ar: عشرة أسابيع في مختبر طبي حيوي رائد

eligibility.en: College sophomores and juniors. International students may apply (the page states this). Visa and work-authorisation details are not given on the page; confirm with the programme.

en: Open the SURF online application (surfapplication.rockefeller.edu)
Complete the application and request recommendations
Submit by 1 February 2027
Decisions are sent in mid-March 2027

costs.en: Paid: USD 6,500 stipend; free housing provided for students who cannot commute. No application fee stated.

score_reason: Prestigious paid lab fellowship; international students may apply; deadline 1 Feb 2027

deadline_note: Applications close Thursday 17 Dec 2026, 5 pm ET (page is headed '2028 Competition' but dates refer to summer 2027).

summary.en: HHMI places undergraduates in HHMI labs at US universities and at Janelia Research Campus for paid summer research; international students enrolled at US institutions with valid status may apply.
summary.ka: HHMI აგზავნის ბაკალავრებს აშშ-ის უნივერსიტეტების HHMI ლაბორატორიებსა და Janelia-ში ანაზღაურებად საზაფხულო კვლევაზე; შეუძლიათ აშშ-ში მოქმედი სტატუსის მქონე საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს.
summary.ar: يضع HHMI طلاب البكალوريوس في مختبراته بالجامعات الأمريكية وفي Janelia لبحث صيفي مدفوع، ويمكن للطلاب الدوليين المسجلين في مؤسسات أمريكية بوضع قانوني ساري التقديم.

about.en:
The Cech Fellows Program (formerly the Janelia summer undergraduate research route) gives undergraduates a summer in an HHMI laboratory at a US research university or at the Janelia Research Campus in Ashburn, Virginia. Fellows receive USD 15,000 at host institutions or USD 12,000 at Janelia with free on-campus housing.

Applicants must be enrolled full-time at an accredited US or US-territory institution and be lawfully permitted to take part through 12 August 2027 (US citizen, permanent resident, or holder of a valid visa/status). HHMI does not sponsor visas. This is therefore open to international students already studying in the US, not to students applying from abroad.

en: USD 12,000-15,000 fellowship
HHMI labs or Janelia Research Campus
International students at US colleges can apply
ka: აშშ-ის კოლეჯებში მოსწავლე საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს შეუძლიათ განაცხადი
ar: الطلاب الدوليون في الكليات الأمريكية يمكنهم التقديم

eligibility.en: Full-time students at an accredited US or US-territory institution who are lawfully permitted to participate through 12 August 2027 (US citizens, permanent residents, or international students with valid visa/status). HHMI does not sponsor visas or pay visa fees. Not open to students enrolled outside the US.

en: Open the Cech Fellows programme page and read the 2027 details
Prepare the online application and recommendations
Submit by 17 December 2026, 5 pm ET

costs.en: Paid: USD 15,000 at host institutions (covers travel, housing, meals; you arrange housing) or USD 12,000 at Janelia including free on-campus housing.

score_reason: Prestigious and well paid but limited to students already enrolled in the US; deadline 17 Dec 2026

deadline_note: Rolling. Summer starts (May-August) have a strict deadline of 1 November of the previous year (1 Nov 2026 has passed; next 1 Nov 2027 for summer 2028). Other start dates: apply at least 5 months ahead.

summary.en: Fully funded research internships at the Max Planck Institutes for Informatics, Software Systems and Security and Privacy, open to students worldwide with about three years of CS study.
summary.ka: სრულად დაფინანსებული კვლევითი ინტერნშიპები მაქს პლანკის ინფორმატიკის, პროგრამული სისტემებისა და უსაფრთხოების ინსტიტუტებში, ღიაა მსოფლიოს სტუდენტებისთვის.
summary.ar: تدريب بحثي ممول بالكامل في معاهد ماكس بلانك للمعلوماتية والأنظمة البرمجية والأمن، ومفتوح لطلاب العالم.

about.en:
The Max Planck Institutes in Computer Science run a joint internship programme in which interns work with a mentor on a research project, usually for 12 to 14 weeks. Interns receive a monthly stipend, housing and round-trip travel.

Bachelor's, master's and doctoral students worldwide can apply, with roughly the first three years of a CS bachelor's completed, a strong record and professional English. German is not required. Selected interns get documents to support a German/Schengen visa application. Applications are accepted year-round but are competitive.

en: Stipend, housing and travel covered
Applicants from abroad welcome
No German required

eligibility.en: Bachelor's, master's and doctoral students worldwide, with roughly the first three years of a CS bachelor's by the start date, a strong academic record and professional English. Applicants from abroad must apply for a German/Schengen visa themselves; support documents are provided.

en: Prepare CV, transcripts (unofficial accepted) and one referee contact; motivation letter optional
Apply online at the internship application portal (not by email)
Apply by 1 November for summer starts, or at least 5 months before another start date
Results for summer applications come by 1 February

costs.en: Fully funded: monthly stipend, housing and round-trip travel. Visa fees may be waived for stays up to 3 months.

score_reason: Fully funded, open worldwide, rolling; strict 1 Nov deadline for summer starts

deadline_note: Annual programme; 2026 selection already published. The 2027 call is not yet announced on the page; ask summertraining@cnio.es.

summary.ar: تدريب صيفي في مختبرات CNIO بمدريد لطلاب البكالوريوس في الطب الحيوي وعلوم الحياة، ومفتوح لطلاب من أي بلد.

about.en:
CNIO's Summer Training Programme gives undergraduates in their final years of biomedicine or life-sciences studies seven to eight weeks of practical training in a cancer research group. The number of places varies by year (4 in 2026).

The page does not state whether positions are paid and the 2027 call is not yet published, so check the page and contact the training office before planning.

en: Hands-on training in a leading cancer research centre
Open to students in any country
Annual summer programme
ka: პრაქტიკული ტრენინგი კიბოს კვლევის წამყვან ცენტრში

eligibility.en: Undergraduates in their final years of biomedicine-related or life-sciences degrees in any country, so international applicants are eligible. Pay and the 2027 timetable are not stated; contact summertraining@cnio.es.

en: Watch the CNIO undergraduate programmes page for the 2027 call
Contact summertraining@cnio.es for the application process and dates
Submit the application when the call opens

costs.en: The page does not say whether the programme is paid or what support is offered; confirm with summertraining@cnio.es.
